newsitem.title: USA: Boat adrift off Florida held smuggled immigrants.
newsitem.headline: Boat adrift off Florida held smuggled immigrants.

text.p: A motorboat found adrift off Florida was carrying eight men from India, Pakistan and Jamaica and two men suspected of attempting to smuggle them into the United States, the Coast Guard said on Monday.

A U.S. fishing boat came across the 18-foot (6-metre) boat drifting in the middle of a storm on Sunday about 40 miles (64 km) east of Vero Beach, Florida. The boat took everyone on board and called the Coast Guard, which took the passengers to Miami, where they were turned over to the border patrol.

The two men suspected of smuggling said they were on a trip from Walkers Cay, Bahamas, to Freeport, Bahamas, when their vessel became disabled and drifted toward Florida. Among the six passengers on board, all men, were six Indians, one Pakistani and one Jamaican. The crew were from the Bahamas.
